title: fix(app-shell): drop redundant Studio designer footer hints for consistency
body:
## What & why

Follow-up to #2296. That PR removed the automation canvas's redundant footer hint (`Click a node → configure on the right · then "Save draft" → "Publish"`). This applies the **same cleanup to the sibling Studio designers** so the whole builder is consistent.

Each pillar already has a top heading / mode pill that explains the surface, so the repeated bottom instructional line is noise on every designer, not just automation.

## Changes

- **InterfacesPillar (IF designer)** — drop the `if.editHint` footer. The contextual "design this in **Data**" hint shown for `object`-type records is **kept** (it's guidance, not boilerplate).
- **DataPillar** — drop the Records-grid (`data.gridHint`) and Layout-form (`data.formHint`) footers.
- **i18n** — remove the now-unused `if.editHint` / `data.gridHint` / `data.formHint` keys, plus the `auto.editHint` key orphaned by #2296, from **both** the English and Chinese tables.

No behavior change beyond removing the three footer lines; `MousePointer2` stays imported (still used by empty-state icons).

## Verification

- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell` (+ deps) — 29/29 pass.
- `vitest run studio-locale.i18n.test.tsx FlowCanvas.test.tsx` — 9/9 pass (locale-catalog parity test still green after key removal).
